name: {{APP_NAME}}

scripts.db:ready: tsx db/ensure-env.ts && docker compose up -d db --wait && prisma migrate deploy && tsx db/init.ts && tsx db/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: tsx db/assert-dev.ts && prisma migrate reset --force && npm run db:seed

//overrides: @hookform/resolvers >=5.4.1 declares peerOptional valibot@^1 while its own @typeschema/valibot dep pins valibot@^0.39 — npm install fails ERESOLVE. We only use the Zod resolver, so forcing valibot to v1 (what resolvers itself wants) resolves it. Remove once upstream fixes its peer tree; the caret range keeps us on latest meanwhile.
//typescript: TypeScript 6, not 7: the 7.x package is the native compiler and ships no JS compiler API, which typescript-eslint (inside eslint-config-next) needs — it refuses to load under 7.0 and tracks support for >=7.1. tsc and next build both work on 7; only lint does not. Bump when typescript-eslint supports 7.
